user.title: PVHub 2.0
user.description: Paste these values from Chrome DevTools -> Network -> the /dew/w/plant/analysis/raw monitoring request. This integration only polls monitoring data and does not control the inverter, battery, meter, or account.

data_description.plant_id: The GROUPID value from the PVHub page URL.
data_description.cookie: Copy the full Cookie request header value.
data_description.token: Copy the Token request header value.
data_description.signature: Copy the Signature request header value.
data_description.timestamp: Copy the Timestamp request header value.
data_description.lang: Copy the Lang request header value, usually en or English.
data_description.timezone: Copy the Timezone request header value, for example Australia/Brisbane.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read PVHub data with these details. Check the endpoint, plant ID, and network connection.
error.auth_failed: PVHub rejected the copied authentication headers. Copy fresh Cookie, Token, Signature, and Timestamp values from Chrome DevTools and try again.

abort.already_configured: This PVHub plant is already configured.

auth_expired.title: PVHub credentials expired
auth_expired.description: PVHub rejected the stored authentication details. Open Chrome DevTools, copy fresh values from the read-only `/dew/w/plant/analysis/raw` request, then reconfigure the PVHub integration with updated Cookie, Token, Signature, and Timestamp values.
